intel.title: [CISA KEV] WSO2 Multiple Products - WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-5430
廠商: WSO2
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability 
說明: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution. 
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-27
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2026-5430）影響 WSO2 多款產品（包括 API Manager 等），屬於路徑遍歷漏洞。攻擊者可利用此漏洞進行未授權的文件上傳，進而執行遠端代碼（RCE）。目前該漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV，顯示已有在野攻擊利用。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Adobe Commerce and Magento  - Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-71362
廠商: Adobe
產品: Commerce and Magento 
漏洞名稱: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability 
說明: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction. 
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-27
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2026-71362）為 Adobe Commerce 及 Magento 的權限繞過漏洞，已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV）。攻擊者可在無需使用者互動的情況下，利用此漏洞提升權限並存取敏感資源。由於本公司並未部署或使用相關產品，因此不受此漏洞影響。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
